title: Single combined pre-launch polish update (Steps 3+4+5) without React Query setup changes

requirements.text: Deliver a single combined frontend polish update covering the remaining pre-launch steps (3, 4, and 5) as one cohesive release, focusing on UX clarity, copy, loading/empty states, and final UI refinements across the main tabs (Home, Insights, Memories, Activities, Us).

quotes: yes, please generate a single combined update next

acceptanceCriteria: All five tabs (Home/Insights/Memories/Activities/Us) have consistent, understandable user-facing text in English.
No pages show confusing blank/empty sections without a helpful empty-state message.
The update ships as a single change-set (no multi-step rollout required).

requirements.text: Add/standardize user-friendly loading states and empty states for key data-driven surfaces (Insights metrics/cards, ritual history lists, photos/memories lists, pairing/partner info panels, and love-language sync panels) without changing React Query configuration or provider setup.

quotes: ensuring the update will avoid any touches to React Query setup

acceptanceCriteria: While data is loading, the UI shows a consistent skeleton/spinner/loading copy instead of flashing empty content.
When data is legitimately absent (e.g., no history yet, not paired yet), the UI shows a clear empty-state with next-step guidance.
No modifications are made to QueryClientProvider placement, QueryClient instantiation, or global React Query defaults.

requirements.text: Polish error handling and recovery UX for failed canister calls (e.g., pairing code check, ritual submission, quiz save/reset, insights fetch) by presenting clear error messages and safe retry actions, without deleting or removing any existing/legacy code paths referenced in the current step 4 plan.

quotes: avoid any touches to React Query setup &/or remove old code paths in step 4.

acceptanceCriteria: When a canister call fails, the user sees an English error message that explains what happened at a high level and offers a retry where appropriate.
No existing code paths are removed; any new logic is additive or guarded so older behavior remains available.
User flows do not get stuck in a perpetual loading state after an error.

requirements.text: Apply lightweight performance and UI responsiveness tweaks that do not involve React Query setup changes (e.g., reduce unnecessary re-renders in high-traffic components, avoid expensive computations during render, and ensure animations do not degrade scrolling).

quotes: generate a single combined update next

acceptanceCriteria: Navigating between tabs feels responsive and avoids noticeable UI jank on common interactions (scrolling lists, opening modals/details, submitting forms).
No React Query provider/client configuration is changed as part of performance work.
No legacy/older code paths are removed as part of cleanup.

requirements.text: Perform a final manual QA pass aligned to the existing checklist and update the checklist only as needed to reflect the combined single-release polish verification steps (without changing app features).
acceptanceCriteria: QA covers: login/logout, profile setup, pairing flow, daily ritual completion/sync, viewing Memories/history, photo add/view/delete, love languages quiz save/reset/sync, insights viewing, and activities gating/spin wheel.
Any checklist edits are limited to clarity/ordering for the combined release and do not add new product features.

constraints: Do not modify React Query setup or configuration (including QueryClientProvider placement, QueryClient creation, or default query options).
Do not remove or delete existing/legacy code paths related to step 4; changes must be additive or safely guarded.

Do not edit files under frontend immutable paths (frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui). Compose or wrap instead.
Backend must remain single-actor in backend/main.mo; add migration.mo only if state changes require it (avoid if not necessary).
All user-facing text introduced/modified in this update must be in English.
nonGoals: Refactoring or consolidating React Query providers/clients, changing caching policies, or altering React Query initialization patterns.
Removing deprecated/unused code paths as part of cleanup.
Implementing new backend analytics/badges logic beyond polish (unless explicitly requested separately).
Adding new product features or new tabs/pages.
